# Goose Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Goose configuration. The main output is `.goosehints`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - goose
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - goose:
      version: full
```

## At a Glance

| Property        | Value                                 |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| **Tier**        | Tier 2                                |
| **Main output** | `.goosehints`                         |
| **Skills**      | Yes (`.goose/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) |
| **Agents**      | No                                    |
| **Commands**    | No                                    |
| **Local files** | No                                    |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                            | Purpose                    |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Main instructions | `.goosehints`                   | Primary rule file          |
| Skills            | `.goose/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Reusable skill definitions |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                    |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single .goosehints file                   |
| `multifile`      | .goosehints + .goose/mcp_config.json      |
| `full` (default) | Multifile + .goose/skills/<name>/SKILL.md |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support                         |
| ------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | `.goose/mcp_config.json` (json) |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported                   |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
